lessons.keep: Carry an everyday metaphor through to the ending rather than abandoning it after the hook.
lessons.avoid: Using a relatable privacy metaphor as a substitute for showing the control.
lessons.open: Funding, customer relationships and privacy implementation are not independently verified; sound remains unreviewed.
